changes.title: Wholesale buy-box, versioned
changes.body: Your wholesale buy-box is saved as a new version every time you change it, with the history kept, so you can see what criteria a deal was measured against. A maximum-allowable-offer calculation sits alongside it on wholesale deals.

changes.title: Delinquency stages on notes
changes.body: Notes you hold now show where each borrower sits — current, under 30 days, 30, 60, or 90+ days past due — based on the payment record.

changes.title: Tax-sale redemption clock and quiet-title gate
changes.body: The redemption clock shows time remaining and the current redemption amount, and the quiet-title step is surfaced on tax-delinquent deals so it isn't skipped.

changes.title: Note tape import
changes.body: Import a note tape and see where each value on the note record came from.

changes.title: Texting consent, kept separate from email
changes.body: A prospecting text now requires written consent on record. Email follows its own opt-out and suppression rules and is no longer tied to texting consent.

changes.title: One-line thread summary in Inbox
changes.body: Open a message and ask for a one-line Pax summary of the thread. It is generated on request and not stored.

changes.title: Team chat
changes.body: A team chat panel is available alongside your work so your team can talk without leaving the page.

changes.title: Use your own data keys
changes.body: Property lookups can run on your own vendor key, managed from your settings.

changes.title: Free statewide parcel lookups
changes.body: Parcel lookups can now use free statewide cadastral sources for supported states.

changes.title: Open-data signals in due diligence
changes.body: Due diligence can draw on IRS migration data, Census building permits, county employment and wages, and recent severe-weather alerts.

changes.title: Parcel detail view
changes.body: Every parcel now has its own page (/parcels/:id) that pulls overview, due diligence, financial, and cross-links into a single composed surface — no more bouncing between four tabs to evaluate one piece of land.

changes.title: Page topbar with global search
changes.body: A sticky breadcrumb topbar now appears on every authenticated page — including theme toggle, notification bell, and ⌘K command palette access — so navigation context is always one keystroke away.

changes.title: Auto-resolve review panel
changes.body: When AcreOS finishes a task on your behalf, cascade candidates (related follow-ups it could resolve too) now surface in a dedicated panel so you stay in control of the chain.

changes.title: Founder's monthly letter
changes.body: Each month you'll receive a personalized brief from Pax — portfolio delta, what worked, what didn't, and one recommended next move. Visit /my-letter to read the latest issue.

changes.title: Founder dashboard tone
changes.body: Migrated the founder dashboard to semantic color tokens so the surface adapts cleanly to dark mode, custom palettes, and reseller white-labels without manual restyling.

changes.title: Blind-offer wizard
changes.body: Generate offers for an entire county in one sitting. The wizard walks through filters, pricing rules, and personalization — then queues mail, email, and SMS in the right cadence.

changes.title: Decisions Inbox for any user
changes.body: The autonomous-decision review queue is no longer founder-only. Every authenticated user can now see and approve the decisions AcreOS is queuing on their org's behalf.

changes.title: Onboarding state is org-scoped
changes.body: Re-inviting a teammate or re-installing the app no longer shows the new-user wizard — onboarding state is tracked at the organization level, not per user.

changes.title: Direct mail integration
changes.body: Trigger postcards and letters directly from a campaign or sequence — no more exporting CSVs to Lob. Track delivery, returned mail, and reply attribution in the same view.

changes.title: Faster pipeline rendering
changes.body: Large pipelines (1,000+ deals) now load in under a second on first paint thanks to virtualized columns and a slimmer initial query.

changes.title: Security and reliability improvements
changes.body: Quiet round of hardening across authentication, session handling, and rate limits. No customer action required.

changes.title: AcreOS v6 — Land Investor positioning
changes.body: We re-grounded the product around Land Investors specifically — pricing tiers, copy, dashboards, and onboarding all speak to the actual workflow of acquiring, financing, and selling land at scale.

changes.title: Native e-signing
changes.body: Send purchase agreements, deeds, and financing notes for signature without leaving AcreOS or paying a third-party signing vendor. External signers receive a tokenized link — no account required.

changes.title: Acquisition Radar
changes.body: A continuous scan across your active counties surfaces parcels matching your buy-box the moment they appear — with seller-intent scoring so you know which to chase first.

changes.title: Pax Copilot rail
changes.body: The right-side AI rail can now act on the page you're looking at — open a deal, draft a follow-up email, or run a comp pull without losing context.

changes.title: Security and reliability improvements
changes.body: Maintenance pass on outbound webhook signing and provider failover behavior.

changes.title: Portfolio P&L
changes.body: A dedicated /portfolio-pnl view rolls up a year of sale proceeds, seller-finance interest income, acquisition cost, and net profit, with cash-on-cash return, an IRR estimate, and a quarterly breakdown.

changes.title: Trial banner clarity
changes.body: Trial countdown now shows days remaining, what you'll keep on the free tier, and a one-click upgrade — no surprise lockouts.
